instructions: The table-summary patch only honors an explicit per-document opt-out. It does not force a retrieval-only instance profile. Unmodified UI upload and reparse remain BLOCKED even if that patch passes its tests.
This whole document is not an API request. Replace the embedding-model placeholder and submit only kb_create_template after admission passes.
Use the regular knowledge-bases API, not the initialization wizard that requires an LLM model.
Send upload_process_config as JSON in the process_config multipart field on every upload. The upload UI otherwise defaults summary_enabled to true.
The sibling upload form field enable_multimodel must be the string false. Its upstream spelling is intentionally retained.
Do not register a paid chat, VLM, OCR or rerank model, enable ask, or fall back to another provider under this profile.
The template is for a newly created knowledge base. Reusing an old knowledge base requires a separate audit of legacy models and enhancement settings.
unsupported_or_unverified_in_this_profil: Scanned or image-only PDFs and standalone images requiring OCR or VLM
Cloud document parsers and any paid parser fallback
Executing or refreshing spreadsheet formulas, Wind add-ins or market data
Agent, ask, Wiki, graph, generated questions, document or table summaries, automatic tags or knowledge-base profiles
required_service_evidence: UI upload/reparse additionally require a separately reviewed server-enforced zero-generation profile covering every summary, question, graph, Wiki, auto-tag, profile and image-generation queue path. This profile is NOT_IMPLEMENTED by the current artifacts.
Exact source, patch, all preimage/postimage hashes and final ARM64 image digest match the admitted candidate.
The included Go table-summary opt-out test passes on the patched source.
Document parsing and retrieval complete with only the authorized embedding endpoint; zero chat, VLM, paid OCR, rerank, Wiki, graph or summary calls occur.
Spreadsheet uploads and reparses do not enqueue table-summary tasks when summary_enabled is false; default-enabled behavior remains unchanged.
